title: Carpet Cleaning Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Carpet Cleaning: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Carpet Cleaning Estimate Worksheet covers carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path. The carpet service coordinator records Residential Carpet Cleaning observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Carpet Cleaning Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Carpet Cleaning exceptions visible until the carpet service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Carpet Cleaning Estimate Worksheet at residence, room, stair, furniture area, entry path, and drying zone. Document carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path identity before Residential Carpet Cleaning begins. Compare carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path findings with stated Residential Carpet Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential Carpet Cleaning issues to cleaning quality reviewer.

sections.title: Customer contact, estimator, and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Carpet Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence, room, stair, furniture area, entry path, and drying zone, and the linked carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path source.

sections.title: Pricing basis, allowances, and exclusions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Carpet Cleaning facts for carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Carpet Cleaning estimate checks
items: Fiber, colorfastness, wear, seam, backing, and pre-existing damage
Stain type, location, age, and prior chemical use
Furniture, electronics, floor transition, and protected surface
Vacuum, precondition, agitation, extraction, and spot-treatment step
Moisture removal, airflow, drying, and access restriction

sections.title: Estimate assumptions and customer decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Carpet Cleaning conditions; have carpet service coordinator assign the next Residential Carpet Cleaning owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Fiber, dye, backing, or adhesive compatibility concern
Damage or stain cannot be safely improved
Drying or access control cannot be maintained
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Carpet Cleaning when contamination, compatibility, damage, drying, or safe-access concern remains. Retain the available Residential Carpet Cleaning proof and route unresolved carpeted room, fiber, backing, stain, furnishing, transition, and extraction path scope to carpet service coordinator.
